title: Read Mapping Tutorial Using Bowtie2
author: Frank Aylward
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.v4pe8vn

steps.title: Initialize Project Environment
steps.instruction: Clone the tutorial repository and enter the directory to ensure all necessary files are present.

steps.title: Download and Prepare Raw Reads
steps.instruction: Download a subset of Illumina transcriptomic reads for M. smegmatis (accession SRR5585000) and verify the file format.

substeps.instruction: Download the first 10,000 reads using `fastq-dump -X 10000 SRR5585000`
Inspect the FASTQ format using `head SRR5585000.fastq`
Optional: Parse reads using `seqkit fx2tab -n -l -i SRR5585000.fastq | head`
Optional: Calculate mean sequence length using `seqkit fx2tab -n -l -i SRR5585000.fastq | datamash mean 4`

steps.title: Download and Prepare Reference Genome
steps.instruction: Obtain the FASTA genome file for mycobacteriophage D29 and decompress it.

steps.title: Index the Reference Genome
steps.instruction: Build a Bowtie2 index of the reference genome to allow for sequence comparison.

substeps.instruction: Run `bowtie2-build D29.fna D29 > bowtie2.log` to create the .bt2 index files and save the output to a log

steps.title: Map Reads to Reference
steps.instruction: Align the unpaired FASTQ reads to the indexed reference genome to generate a SAM file.

substeps.instruction: Inspect the resulting SAM file using `head T1.sam` and `tail T1.sam`

steps.title: Process SAM to Sorted BAM
steps.instruction: Convert the SAM file to a binary BAM format, filter out unmapped reads, sort the alignments, and index the final file.

substeps.instruction: Convert SAM to BAM and remove unmapped reads (flag 4) using `samtools view -bS -F 4 T1.sam > T1.bam`
Sort the BAM file using `samtools sort T1.bam T1.sort` (Note: if error occurs, use `-o` flag to specify `mapping_out.sort.bam`)
Index the sorted BAM file using `samtools index T1.sort.bam`

steps.title: Verify Mapping Statistics
steps.instruction: Generate summary statistics from the indexed BAM file to confirm the number of mapped reads.

substeps.instruction: Run `samtools idxstats T1.sort.bam` and verify that 13,670 reads mapped
